note: What the Treasure tool rolls from. Amounts follow the Dungeon Master's Guide (2024) by tier, with about half its magic items (Treasure [RUL-620]). Item names are from the DMG 2024, Xanathar's Guide to Everything (XGE), Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (TCE) and Spelljammer: Adventures in Space (SJ), with a few from Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage (WDMM), Ghosts of Saltmarsh (GoS), The Book of Many Things (BMT) and Acquisitions Incorporated (AI); Star Map has no rules in any of them. The world's own items come from the catalogue.

marches.label: The Hollow Marches
marches.coins: Coins of a dozen kingdoms, some of which nobody remembers.

legion.label: The Tyrant's Dominion
legion.coins: Legion iron-stamped gold, and arena tokens.

consortium.label: The Fractured Nexus
consortium.coins: Prism-cut Consortium coins, a few still faintly glowing.

pact.label: The Eternal Veil
pact.coins: Masked coins of Noctis, every face different.

wildborn.label: The Verdant Rebirth
wildborn.coins: Few coins; the clans value what they can use.

kaelmar-west.label: Ashvale and the Western Hills
kaelmar-west.coins: Barter country: most of a hoard's worth is in goods, not coin.

kaelmar.label: Kaelmar beyond the west
kaelmar.coins: Kaelholm silver, dwarven gold from the north, and Kaelith tokens nobody spends.

ethereal.label: The Ethereal Realm
ethereal.coins: Coins of lost worlds. They fade once taken out, and can't be anchored.
